statusDefinitions.browser-computed: Computed directly in the browser by a maintained Foko Lab numerical core.
statusDefinitions.derived-browser: Derived in the browser from a computed finite result; interpretation remains conditional on that result.
statusDefinitions.limited-browser: Available with explicit finite-sample, finite-difference, reduced-model, or dimensionality limits.
statusDefinitions.export-only: Represented in the taxonomy and export guidance, but not computed by the browser core.
statusDefinitions.unavailable: Not offered because the required numerical method is absent; no substitute result is shown.

methods.label: Finite Difference Sensitivity
methods.runtime: Central finite differences for scalar metrics and propagated trajectories, with perturbation-step convergence evidence.

methods.label: Local Jacobian Sensitivity
methods.runtime: Finite-difference state Jacobian ∂f/∂x, parameter Jacobian ∂f/∂p, and parameter-to-state trajectory influence along the nominal solution.

methods.label: One-Factor-at-a-Time Sensitivity
methods.runtime: Bounded parameter sweeps with all nonselected parameters fixed at the nominal point; interactions are not included.

methods.label: Directional Sensitivity
methods.runtime: User-specified direction normalized in declared parameter-range coordinates and evaluated over a bounded profile.

methods.label: Two-Parameter Response Surface
methods.runtime: Optional bounded grid over two declared parameter ranges with all remaining parameters nominal; browser workload is capacity-guarded.

methods.label: Adjoint Sensitivity
methods.reason: No objective-specific backward adjoint, checkpointing, event handling, or finite-difference verification contract is implemented.

plots.label: Parameter Jacobian Heatmap
plots.scope: Mean absolute right-hand-side derivative ∂fᵢ/∂pⱼ along the nominal trajectory; not propagated trajectory sensitivity.

plots.label: State Jacobian Heatmap
plots.scope: Mean absolute right-hand-side derivative ∂fᵢ/∂xⱼ along the nominal trajectory; not a stability certificate.

plots.label: Trajectory Sensitivity Heatmap
plots.scope: Finite-difference ∂x(t)/∂p for the selected output trajectory.

plots.label: Tornado Plot
plots.scope: Endpoint changes over the full declared parameter ranges; not a global variance decomposition.

plots.label: Residual Component Sensitivity
plots.reason: A generic ODE trajectory has no canonical residual-component decomposition. This plot is only meaningful in residual-defined fitting, algebraic, or future PINN workflows.

methods.label: Jansen / Saltelli variance indices
methods.runtime: Sensitivity Lab Jansen first/total estimators plus optional symmetrized Saltelli pairwise second-order interactions for independent uniform parameter ranges.

methods.label: Morris Screening
methods.runtime: Sensitivity Lab seeded Morris OAT trajectories with elementary-effect distributions, prefix convergence and bootstrap rank stability.

methods.label: Mutual Information Screening
methods.runtime: Quantile-bin normalized mutual information on a bounded subset of the actual global sample design with coarse permutation screening; not a variance fraction.

methods.label: HSIC Screening
methods.runtime: Normalized RBF-kernel HSIC with median-distance bandwidth on a bounded sample subset and coarse permutation screening; not a Sobol index.

methods.label: FAST / eFAST
methods.reason: No validated frequency assignment, spectral estimator, or eFAST sampling design is implemented.

methods.label: Shapley Effects
methods.reason: No conditional-expectation engine for dependent inputs or tractable validated browser estimator is implemented.

plots.label: Second-Order Interaction Heatmap
plots.scope: Optional symmetrized Saltelli pairwise estimator; independent inputs and guarded browser budget.

plots.label: Time-Resolved Total-Effect Heatmap
plots.scope: Jansen first/total estimates at downsampled times using the same seeded A/B/mixed design; no extra ODE solves.

plots.label: Variance-Contribution Accounting
plots.scope: Raw finite-sample first-order, optional pairwise, and unresolved remainder accounting. No cosmetic clipping or forced closure.

plots.label: Parameter–Output Relationship Matrix
plots.scope: Bounded subset of the actual global sample design; visual relationship diagnostic, not an index estimator.

plots.label: FAST Spectrum
plots.reason: A Fourier plot without a valid FAST/eFAST sampling design would not be a sensitivity spectrum.

plots.label: Shapley Value Plot
plots.reason: A dependent-input conditional-expectation engine is not implemented.

plots.label: Morris Normalized Parameter Trajectories
plots.scope: Displays a bounded subset of the actual normalized one-at-a-time design paths.

plots.label: Parameter × State Total-Effect Heatmap
plots.scope: Selected scalar metric applied to each state using the same seeded Jansen design.

plots.label: Parameter × State First-Order Heatmap
plots.scope: Selected scalar metric applied to each state using the same seeded Jansen design.

plots.label: Global Two-Parameter Response Surface
plots.scope: Optional bounded grid in Global variance mode; all remaining parameters fixed nominal.

methods.label: Profile Likelihood
methods.runtime: Curve Fitting finite profile SSE scans.

methods.label: Fisher Information Matrix
methods.runtime: Sensitivity Lab range-scaled local trajectory FIM approximation; Curve Fitting retains fit-specific local information diagnostics.

integrationPolicy.runtimeMenus: Only entries backed by current computed data are selectable in plot dropdowns.
integrationPolicy.referenceCatalog: Unavailable and export-only entries remain visible in capability catalogues with an explicit reason.
integrationPolicy.scientificBoundary: Taxonomy membership is not evidence that a method is implemented or validated.
integrationPolicy.sensitivityLab: Runtime entries identify the first-class Sensitivity Analysis Lab. Local finite-difference, Jacobian, OFAT, directional and bounded surface diagnostics; Morris effects and normalized design trajectories; first/total/second-order variance, time- and state-resolved effects; and limited dependence diagnostics are browser-guarded. Oversized requests are refused before a worker starts; adjoints, FAST/eFAST, and Shapley effects remain export-only.
